The test image shows soybean pods with large, irregular dark brown to purple-black blotchy lesions covering significant portions of the pod surface. One pod shows a circular lesion with a pinkish/tan center. The pods are still green but heavily infected.

Comparing with the Anthracnose reference: the bottom-right panel shows a green soybean pod with irregular dark brown lesions — this matches the test image closely. Anthracnose is known for dark, irregularly shaped spots on pods, and the blotchy, dark discoloration pattern with irregular margins is characteristic.

The circular pinkish lesion center could represent an acervulus (the "pin cushion-like" structure mentioned in Anthracnose descriptions).
